proposals.evidence: DEDR 5020 Toda: mudk in front; next year (? -k dative suffix); muda·l first; mubo·y fas̱ front teeth; mun in front (MBE 1974b, p. 64, K78); former ( mun go·s̱tk in former times, < *mun go·s̱m, DBIA , no. 97); mïn sharp point, top of hill; mïnp sharp end… The Toda subsection gives mudk “in front” and muda·l “first”; source madalk “before” has the temporal/front sense.
